title: 3-SPEED AUTO TRANS-REAR AXLE & PROP SHAFT
summary: Driveshaft (propeller shaft) and differential for the 3-speed automatic (RPO M40). The prop shaft's rear U-joint is held to the differential pinion flange (companion flange) by bolts and U-joint straps; the front slip yoke gets chassis grease and slides into the transmission. Line up the paint mark on the shaft with the paint mark on the pinion flange. Differential mounting hardware is production (see base sheets).

parts.name: STRAP
parts.name_expanded: Strap – U-joint bearing cap to pinion flange

materials.where: front slip yoke of prop shaft [2] (transmission end)

fastening.note: Bolts [1] go through straps [3] over the rear U-joint bearing caps into the pinion flange of the differential carrier [4]. Align the paint marks on shaft and pinion flange.
Carrier [4] mounting bolts, nuts, cotter pin and bracket are production parts (callout A), not listed here.

notes: NOTE: When assembling prop. shaft to differential carrier, position paint mark on prop. shaft inline with paint mark on pinion flange of differential carrier.
